propositions: No pullable Jira DC test image exists; the harness must build from a vendored Dockerfile that pins the addono base digest and reproduces the pycontribs/jira wrapper logic.

The vendored Dockerfile requires -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout on the atlas-run entrypoint; removing either causes silent startup failure (Marketplace v1 endpoint retired, Cargo 600s deploy ceiling).
The Docker image does not contain Jira; atlas-run downloads it at runtime from maven.atlassian.com, making egress a hard dependency and first-start dominated by a ~900-artifact fetch.

PAT bearer authentication (used by the DC transport) must be exercised against a real Jira 8.14+ instance via programmatic token creation at POST /rest/pat/latest/tokens and validation in an Authorization: Bearer request.
The harness runs only on native amd64; emulated arm64 has unbounded startup time and cannot be relied upon for acceptance evidence.
Teardown must verify issue deletion via direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} endpoint polling to 404, never via search, per ADR 0037 index-independence discipline.
